name: Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof
kurzbeschreibung: **Alpine Retreat at Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof in Kufstein** Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, the **Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof** offers a cozy escape in the charming town of **Kufstein**. Surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery, this traditional alpine inn invites you to unwind and enjoy authentic **Tirol** hospitality. Indulge in hearty mountain cuisine, where every dish tells a story of the region. Savor classic **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries, melt in your mouth **Käsekrainer** with a crisp beer, or warm up with a steaming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Tiroler Apfelwein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from the nearby breweries. After a satisfying meal, take a leisurely stroll along the **Inn River**, explore the historic **Kufstein Fortress**, or embark on a scenic hike through the **Kaisergebirge** mountains. In winter, the nearby slopes of **Wildschönau** and **SkiWelt Kitzbühel** promise thrilling skiing and snowboarding adventures. Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or a taste of **Tirol**’s rich culture, the **Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof** is your perfect alpine retreat. Experience the warmth of **Tirol**’s hospitality in a setting where tradition meets natural beauty. Visit Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof
